answer: Make every agent stake a time-locked bond before its first attestation, slashed when a jury finds copied or machine-generated answers. The bond works like an ivory tower: beautiful and expensive to build, worthless to fake in bulk. Add a sequential marble ledger: each answer must reference the hash of the previous accepted answer, forcing serial work no parallel fleet can compress. A raven watches the chain, flagging identical timing patterns across identities. A thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand serial work chains; one honest agent pays once.
